title: English Practice Quiz 0902
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A filing system helps an office ___.
questions.explanation: organise and retrieve documents efficiently is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An incoming mail register records ___.
questions.explanation: details of correspondence received is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A document marked 'draft' is generally ___.
options: not yet the final approved version
questions.explanation: not yet the final approved version is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A reference number on correspondence helps ___.
questions.explanation: identify and track the document is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Before archiving a record, staff should check ___.
questions.explanation: the retention and classification procedure is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A circular is commonly used to ___.
options: communicate the same information to a group
questions.explanation: communicate the same information to a group is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A duplicate document is ___.
options: an additional copy of an existing document
questions.explanation: an additional copy of an existing document is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A dispatch register records correspondence ___.
questions.explanation: sent out by the organisation is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Why withdraw obsolete forms?
options: To prevent staff from using outdated versions
questions.explanation: To prevent staff from using outdated versions is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Document control helps ensure staff use ___.
questions.explanation: the correct and current version is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
